research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Casetext is researching systems for natural language database generation and query to update databases from legal text, and a text generation interface system and generative text model query system that craft prompts to identify factual assertions and answer questions. It develops hallucination detection and remediation in text generation interface systems and a large language model artificial intelligence text evaluation system for relevance scoring, along with query evaluation and text reduction and analysis interfaces to support structured document generation. These efforts span prompt engineering, relevance modeling, hallucination control, and structured drafting.

overview_description.description: Casetext has used A.I. legal research technology, that has been adopted across the legal market. Its award-winning technology offers both conventional search functionality and its CARA A.I. powered contextual search, which focuses on the context of research to help find on-point authorities faster. Founded by a team of former litigators from top law firms, as well as Ph.D. data scientists and leading A.I. engineers, Casetext helps legal researchers find the cases, including many that they would otherwise miss.

product.name: CoCounsel
product.description: An AI legal assistant that automates a variety of legal tasks including document review, legal research, contract analysis, and deposition preparation.

product.name: Draft Correspondence
product.description: A tool within CoCounsel that rapidly drafts common legal letters and emails based on specified recipient, topic, and tone.

product.name: Review Documents
product.description: A CoCounsel feature that answers research questions about a set of documents, providing explanations and citing supporting sources.

product.name: Legal Research Memo
product.description: A CoCounsel skill that generates legal research memos answering questions with explanations and supporting sources.

product.name: Prepare for a Deposition
product.description: A CoCounsel function that creates thorough deposition outlines by analyzing information about the deponent and case issues.

product.name: Extract Contract Data
product.description: A CoCounsel skill that analyzes contracts line-by-line and answers user questions about contract content, highlighting relevant passages.
